1 import type { Metadata } from "next"; 2 import Image from "next/image"; 3 import Link from "next/link"; 4 import { ContactCta } from "@/components/contact-cta"; 5 import type { FaqItem } from "@/components/landing/landing-faq"; 6 import { INK, SHOP } from "@/components/home/street-kit"; 7 import { buildsFor } from "@/components/web-catalogue/web-catalogue"; 8 import { BOOKING_HREF, BOOKING_NOTE } from "@/lib/booking"; 9 import { 10 CARE_CHANGES_LINE, 11 CARE_CHANGE_LIMIT, 12 CARE_LITE, 13 CARE_LITE_AMOUNT, 14 EXTRA_HOURLY, 15 EXTRA_HOURLY_CLIENT, 16 OWNERSHIP_LINE, 17 PLAN_INCLUDES, 18 PLAN_STOP_CARE, 19 SEO_AUDIT, 20 SEO_AUDIT_BUY_URL, 21 SEO_ONGOING, 22 SEO_ONGOING_12MO, 23 SEO_ONGOING_6MO, 24 SEO_ONGOING_EXTRA_SCOPE, 25 VISIBILITY_LINE, 26 WEB_ADDONS, 27 WEB_FROM, 28 WEB_TIERS, 29 offerPrice, 30 } from "@/lib/pricing"; 31 import { OFFER_CATALOG_ID, ORG_ID } from "@/lib/organisation"; 32 import { STARTER_FASHION_BUILDS, TEMPLATE_VERTICALS, lookPortrait } from "@/lib/templates"; 33 34 /* LAYOUT: "Colour bands", picked by Macdara from the static /pricing workshop 35 * on 2026-10-01 (redesign step 5).
